Compact upright full-body seated pose (standing for llama/meerkat), three-quarter view. Portrait4:5 silhouette, feet at bottom, natural warm studio lighting. Genuinely transparent background. No scene, base, floor, text, glow, aura, or photographic textures.
entries.cleanupPrompt: Remove the small meerkat companion completely. Keep ONLY the single golden lion, with the same friendly sculpted 3D animation style, golden mane and ruby forehead jewel. Preserve lion's complete four paws, seated body and curled tail; make the newly exposed side complete and natural. Isolated transparent background, no other animal, no aura, ground or shadows. One lion only.
